description: Maps the sector names that ETF providers publish (GICS sectors; matched case-insensitively) to the sector groups of sector_map_v1.json, for the ETF look-through of the sector overview. A provider sector is mapped only where it fits exactly one group. A sector that spans several groups, fits none, or is not a sector (cash, derivatives, other) is listed under not_mapped with the reason and stays its own unmapped category in the overview - it is never put into a group by name or size. Change an entry here only on the basis of provider data that splits the sector (for example sub-industry weights).

not_mapped.Real Estate: no sector group for real estate
not_mapped.Others: not a sector (the provider does not say which sectors)
